title: Chronos — Time / Pattern Perception
description:
Chronos is the Time / Pattern Perception layer of the cognitive stack
(Mnemos → Chronos → Nous → Praxis). It ingests time-series observations
via domain-specific adapters and emits structured signals — Recurrence,
Trend, Spike, Drop, Stall, Anomaly, Seasonality, Correlation. Each signal
carries Pattern, Strength (intensity), Confidence (sureness), Window,
Evidence, and Metrics. Chronos perceives change; it does not interpret,
decide, render prose, or execute actions — those are Nous / Praxis concerns.

features.title: Core domain types
features.description:
Pure types in internal/domain — Signal, Evidence, TimeWindow, PatternType
enum, plus Validate / Normalise. No I/O, no prose, no imports outside
stdlib + google/uuid + chronos.

requirements.description: Signal carries Pattern, Series, Window, Strength, Confidence, Evidence, Metrics.
Domain types must not carry Title, Summary, Suggestion, dismissal, or feedback fields.
Validate enforces non-zero IDs, non-empty features, and label/feature length parity.

features.title: Public adapter SDK (chronos package)
features.description:
Top-level chronos package — EntityState, Source interface, registry
(Register, Get, Adapters). Adapter authors import this.

requirements.description: Source has Name() string and Fetch(ctx, cfg) ([]EntityState, error).
Register panics on nil source or empty name; Get / Adapters expose registered sources.
Last feature is the outcome metric; higher is conventionally better.

features.title: Public HTTP client SDK (client/)
features.description:
client/ package — HTTP-API SDK for consumers (Nous integrators, dashboards,
runtimes) reading signals from a running Chronos server.

requirements.description: c.Signals().Scope(id).Pattern(...).List(ctx) reads signals from a server.
WithToken, WithLogger, WithTimeout, WithUserAgent are the supported options.
WithToken sets the Authorization Bearer header.

features.title: Outbound ports (per-aggregate repositories)
features.description:
internal/ports — outbound interfaces. Per-aggregate repositories following
Interface Segregation.

requirements.description: EntityStateRepository has Ingest, Save (batch), ListByScope, ListByEntity, DeleteOlderThan, Count.
SignalRepository has Save, List(filter), Get, Count — no Dismiss, no Active.
There is no FeedbackRepository in Chronos; reviewer feedback lives in Mnemos.

features.title: Similarity math
features.description: Pure-math package (cosine, weighted, Euclidean) used by detectors. No I/O.

features.title: Detection engine
features.description:
internal/detect — Engine + Detector interface. Engine groups input states by
scope, sorts each group ascending by timestamp, fans out to all registered
detectors, sorts output and caps at MaxSignalsPerRun.

requirements.description: Detector has Pattern() and Detect(ctx, scopeID, []EntityState) []Signal.
Detectors operate within a ScopeID; the engine never compares across scopes.
Output is sorted by detected-at desc, then by confidence desc.

features.title: Detector — Recurrence
features.description:
For each entity's most recent state, look at strictly historical states of
OTHER entities in the same scope. Cosine similarity ≥ threshold counts as a
similar peer. Strength = avg(peer similarity). Confidence = strength × min(samples/5, 1).
Evidence kind similar_state with metrics["outcome_diff"] = peer.outcome - subject.outcome.

features.title: Detector — Trend
Detector — Spike / Drop
features.description:
Z-score of most recent outcome against previous SpikeWindow points. Trigger:
|z| >= threshold in configured direction. Strength = min(|z|/5, 1); metrics
carry z, baseline mean / stddev. Evidence kind baseline_deviation.

features.title: Detector — Stall
features.description:
Normalised stddev of outcomes below StallMaxStdDev over at least StallMinPoints.
Strength reflects flatness (1 - normalised_stddev / threshold). Evidence kind
variance_window.

features.title: Detector — Anomaly
features.description:
Cross-entity dual of Recurrence. For each entity's most recent state,
cosine-compare to peers' most recent states; emit when highest peer similarity
is below AnomalyMaxSimilarity. Strength = 1 - max_similarity. Evidence kind
peer_distance, one per peer.

features.title: Detector — Seasonality
features.description:
Pearson autocorrelation at lags [MinPeriod, n/2]. Emit when largest peak exceeds
SeasonalityMinAutocorr. Strength = peak value; metrics carry the period (lag).
Evidence kind autocorrelation_peak.

features.title: Detector — Correlation
features.description:
Pairwise Pearson on aligned outcome series within a scope. One signal per pair,
deterministically owned by the lex-smaller series ID; the other appears as evidence.
Strength = |r|; metrics carry r and direction. Evidence kind pair_correlation.
Cost is O(N²) in series count per scope.

features.title: Compute pipeline orchestrator
features.description:
internal/pipeline — Compute(ctx, ComputeInput) runs fetch → save observations →
detect → save signals. CHRONOS_JOB_TIMEOUT bounds the whole run as a
context.WithTimeout.

features.title: Store backend — memory
features.description: Thread-safe in-memory backend used for tests and ephemeral exploration.

features.title: Store backend — SQLite
features.description:
Pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite driver. PRAGMAs (foreign_keys=1, journal_mode=wal,
busy_timeout=5000) encoded in the DSN. Migration embedded via
go:embed migrations/001_initial.sql. sqlc-generated code in
internal/store/sqlite/sqlcgen/.

requirements.description: To change SQL, edit sql/sqlite/queries.sql and/or the migration, then run make sqlc.

features.title: Store backend — Postgres
features.description:
Hand-written queries (Postgres is the secondary backend). Schema embedded via
go:embed from internal/store/postgres/migrations/001_initial.sql. Filters compose
positional placeholders for parametrised execution.

features.title: Store factory
features.description:
internal/store.Open(ctx, dbType, connStr) returns a uniform port-typed *Conn
wiring EntityStateRepository and SignalRepository over a shared *sql.DB
(memory / sqlite / postgres).

features.title: HTTP API
features.description:
internal/api — HTTP transport with SignalDTO and IngestRequest. Strictly
transport, no rendering of human-readable copy. SIGINT / SIGTERM drains in-flight
requests for up to 10s before shutdown.

requirements.description: POST /v1/ingest is the streaming entry point.
API does not render prose; the wire shape carries structured fields only.
Shutdown drains in-flight requests for up to 10 seconds.

features.title: Command-line interface
features.description:
cmd/chronos — hand-rolled CLI (no Cobra). Subcommands compute, serve, version.
Failures return *ChronosError{Code, Message, Cause, Hint}; main translates them
into stderr output and exit codes. CHRONOS_VERBOSE=1 reveals the cause chain.

requirements.description: compute accepts --scope-id (preferred) or --coach-id (legacy alias).

features.title: Adapter — Ascend
features.description:
adapters/ascend — bundled working adapter backed by PostgreSQL. Divides tonnage
by bodyweight to normalise features so cosine similarity is meaningful across
athletes of different sizes.

features.title: Configuration system
features.description:
Env-var driven (CHRONOS_*). Defaults in config.Default(). Precedence:
CLI flags > env vars > defaults. Detectors have their own knob namespaces
(CHRONOS_<DETECTOR>_*).

features.title: Observability
features.description:
Logging via log/slog at info level to stderr (text handler). Libraries return
errors; only cmd/ and internal/api log.

features.title: Push notifications (webhook + SSE)
features.description:
Outbound delivery of newly-detected signals so consumers don't have to poll.
Two transports, both transport-only: webhooks for cross-process delivery
with HMAC signing, and Server-Sent Events for in-process / browser dashboards.
At-most-once delivery semantics; consumers de-duplicate by Signal.ID.

requirements.description: ports.Notifier interface; fire-and-forget; failures must not propagate to persistence.
HMAC-SHA256-signed POST with X-Chronos-Signature, X-Chronos-Delivery, X-Chronos-Event headers; best-effort retry on 5xx.
GET /v1/signals/stream with text/event-stream; bounded per-client buffer, drops slow consumers.
Background detection inside serve so SSE has signals to stream; configurable interval.

constraints.description:
Chronos perceives; Nous interprets. No Title, Summary, or Suggestion in domain
or wire types. No dismissal, feedback, or IsActive. Those are Nous / Mnemos
concerns.

The core engine knows nothing about the domain it serves. All domain knowledge
enters only through adapters producing chronos.EntityState. Domain-specific code
must not leak into internal/ or the top-level chronos package.

Dependency direction: domain → ports → similarity → detect → store → pipeline →
api → cmd. Inner layers must not import outer layers. internal/domain has no
imports outside stdlib + google/uuid + chronos.
Last feature is the outcome metric. Higher is conventionally better.
ScopeID is the grouping primitive. Detectors never compare across scopes.
Once detected and persisted, signals are immutable. No mutation on read.

Tests are stdlib-only and table-driven where useful. SQLite tests use :memory:
to exercise the real driver.
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, docs:, test:, chore:, ...).
Wrap errors with %w. Libraries return errors; only cmd/ and internal/api log.
Targets Go 1.23. CI runs Go 1.22 and 1.23.
